section.content: The utility model relates to a biological gene technical field specifically is a biological gene extraction element, the device comprises a device body, the device body includes the extraction element main part, the mouth of puting in has been seted up to the one end of extraction element main part, the inside fixed mounting of extraction element main part has broken storehouse, the inside of extraction element main part is provided with broken mechanism, and the one end of broken mechanism extends to the inside in broken storehouse. The utility model discloses a be provided with fixed case, liquid nitrogen pump main part, connecting pipe, fixed plate, delivery pump, shunt tubes and shower nozzle, after the gene is drawed out, through the start-up to liquid nitrogen pump main part and delivery pump, the gene injection in to the gene collecting box inside of liquid nitrogen that makes its produce to freezing the gene, keeping the bright activity of gene, avoiding it to take place to pollute and degrade, and then being convenient for carry out genetic engineering's research, promoted the reliability of this device.

本实用新型涉及生物基因技术领域，具体为一种生物基因提取装置，包括装置本体，所述装置本体包括提取装置主体，所述提取装置主体的一端开设有投放口，所述提取装置主体的内部固定安装有破碎仓，所述提取装置主体的内部设置有破碎机构，且破碎机构的一端延伸至破碎仓的内部。本实用新型通过设置有固定箱、液氮泵主体、连接管、固定板、输送泵、分流管和喷头，当基因被提取出来后，通过对液氮泵主体和输送泵的启动，使其产生的液氮通过喷头向基因收集箱内部中的基因喷射，从而对基因进行冷冻，保持基因的鲜活性，避免其发生污染和降解，进而便于进行基因工程的研究，提升了本装置的可靠性。

Biological gene extraction deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biological gene technical field specifically is a biological gene extraction element.

Background

The gene is a whole nucleotide sequence required for producing a polypeptide chain or functional RNA, supports the basic structure and performance of life, stores all information of the processes of race, blood type, inoculation, growth, apoptosis and the like of life, depends on the environment and heredity, deduces important physiological processes of multiplication, cell division, protein synthesis and the like of life, and all life phenomena of growth, decay, disease, aging, death and the like of organisms are related to the gene.

Along with the development of society, biotechnology is also more and more developed, and genetic engineering's development is also more and more rapid, and genetic engineering's research then need to draw biological gene, and draw then need use relevant instrument and equipment, for example the biological gene that CN211946990U disclosed draws the instrument, and it is provided with centrifuge, oscillator, boiling water bath unit and robotic arm, and robotic arm presss from both sides and gets centrifuge tube arrives operation panel department adds the medicine, and the process on the test tube operating device after the stirring of stirring piece, to centrifuge department, will the centrifuge tube place in on the fixed station, utilize movable claw will the bottle cap lid closes, opens centrifuge carries out the centrifugation, after accomplishing, robotic arm presss from both sides and gets the centrifuge tube, utilizes movable claw will the bottle cap is opened, will supernatant in the centrifuge tube utilizes draw the mechanism suction, the gene can be obtained by precipitation below, so that human participation is not needed in the process, manpower is liberated, and medical staff experimenters have time to perform other work, so that the working efficiency is improved, but the following problems still exist.

After biological gene extraction is completed, the device can not refrigerate the gene in time, so that the gene can be influenced by external factors, the conditions of pollution and gene degradation appear, and the research on the gene can be influenced to a certain extent, so that the biological gene extraction device needs to be designed.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a biological gene extraction element to solve and to propose in the above-mentioned background art because the device can't be to the timely cold-stored processing that carries on of gene, lead to the gene can receive external factor's influence, the condition of appearing polluting and gene degradation appears, thereby can lead to the fact the problem of certain influence to the research of gene.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a biological gene extraction device comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises an extraction device main body, one end of the extraction device main body is provided with a putting opening, a crushing bin is fixedly installed inside the extraction device main body, a crushing mechanism extending into the crushing bin is arranged inside the extraction device main body, the bottom end of the crushing bin is movably provided with a filter box, the bottom end of the filter box is fixedly provided with a purification box, and one end of the extraction device main body is fixedly provided with a feeding opening communicated with the purification box; the other side of the purification box is communicated with a filter bin, a filter mechanism is arranged in the filter bin, and a waste liquid collecting box is movably arranged at the bottom end of the filter mechanism.

As an alternative of the technical scheme of the utility model, one end of the filtering bin is fixedly provided with a storage box, the interior of the storage box is movably provided with a gene collecting box, the front of the storage box is fixedly provided with a control panel, the interior of the storage box is provided with a refrigerating mechanism, the refrigerating mechanism comprises a fixed box, the top end of the storage box is fixedly provided with a fixed box, the interior of the fixed box is fixedly provided with a liquid nitrogen pump main body, one end of the liquid nitrogen pump main body is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe, one end of the connecting pipe passes through the fixed box and extends to the interior of the storage box, the interior of the storage box is fixedly provided with a fixed plate, the interior of the fixed plate is fixedly provided with a conveying pump, one end of the conveying pump is fixedly connected with one end of the connecting pipe, one end of the conveying pump passes through the fixed plate and extends to the interior of the storage box, one end fixed mounting of delivery pump has the shunt tubes, the even fixed mounting of one end of shunt tubes has the shower nozzle.

As the utility model discloses technical scheme's an alternative, the viewing window has all been seted up with the front of filtering the storehouse to the extraction element main part.

As the utility model discloses technical scheme's an alternative, the inside of putting in mouthful is provided with sealing mechanism, sealing mechanism includes the cavity, put in the inside one end of mouthful and seted up the cavity, the inside fixed mounting of cavity has a connecting axle, the one end movable mounting of a connecting axle has the closing plate, the inside fixed mounting of putting in mouthful has the fixed block, the one end fixed mounting of fixed block has a spring, and the one end of a spring is connected with the one end of closing plate, the one end fixed mounting of putting in mouthful has a connecting plate, the one end fixed mounting of a connecting plate has No. two springs, No. two limiting rod of one end fixedly connected with of spring, the spacing groove has been seted up to the one end of closing plate, the one end of a limiting rod is passed and is put in mouthful and extend to the inside of spacing groove.

As the utility model discloses technical scheme's an alternative, broken mechanism's fixed surface has cup jointed the scraper blade, and the one end of scraper blade is laminated with the inner wall in broken storehouse mutually.

As the utility model discloses technical scheme's an alternative, the bottom of crossing the filter bin is provided with discharge mechanism, discharge mechanism includes the mount, the bottom fixed mounting who crosses the filter bin has the mount, the inside movable mounting of mount has drive screw, the one end fixed mounting that drive screw extends to the mount outside has the transport runner, drive screw's surface activity has cup jointed the transmission piece, the one end fixed mounting of transmission piece has the block pole, No. one the draw-in groove has been seted up to waste liquid collecting box's bottom, the one end of block pole is passed the mount and is extended to the inside of a draw-in groove.

As the utility model discloses technical scheme's an alternative, the one end of saving the case is provided with stop gear, stop gear includes No. two connecting plates, the one end fixed mounting of saving the case has No. two connecting plates, there is adjusting bolt in the inside of No. two connecting plates through screw thread movable mounting, adjusting bolt's one end movable mounting has No. three connecting plates, the even fixed mounting of one end of No. three connecting plates has No. two connecting axles, the equal movable mounting of one end of No. two connecting axles has No. two gag lever posts, two No. two springs of fixedly connected with between No. two gag lever posts, No. two draw-in grooves have been seted up to the one end of gene collecting box, the even fixed mounting in inside of No. two draw-in grooves has the fixture block, the one end of No. two gag lever posts all extends to the inside of No. two draw-in grooves and block each other with the fixture block.

As the utility model discloses technical scheme's an alternative, the inside of mount is provided with slide mechanism, slide mechanism includes the slide rail, the inside fixed mounting of mount has the slide rail, the spout has been seted up to the one end of slide rail, the inside slidable mounting of spout has the slider, and the one end of slider and the one end fixed connection of transmission piece.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that:

1. through being provided with fixed case, liquid nitrogen pump main part, connecting pipe, fixed plate, delivery pump, shunt tubes and shower nozzle, after the gene was drawed out, through the start-up to liquid nitrogen pump main part and delivery pump, the gene injection in the liquid nitrogen that makes its produce to gene collecting box inside through the shower nozzle to freezing the gene, keeping the bright activity of gene, avoiding it to take place to pollute and degrade, and then be convenient for carry out genetic engineering's research, promoted the reliability of this device.

2. Through being provided with the cavity, a connecting axle, the closing plate, the fixed block, a spring, a connecting plate, No. two springs, a gag lever post and spacing groove, utilize the elasticity of No. two springs to make a gag lever post block back in the inside of spacing groove, make the closing plate seal the mouth of puting in to avoid drawing the in-process, external impurity gets into inside through puting in the mouth and causes the influence to extracting of gene, has increased certain extraction efficiency, has promoted the security of this device.

Detailed Description

Referring to fig. 1-7, the present invention provides an embodiment:

a biological gene extraction device comprises a device body 100, wherein a liquid nitrogen pump main body 211 and a delivery pump 214 used in the device are directly available products on the market, the principle and the connection mode of the liquid nitrogen pump main body 211 and the delivery pump 214 are the prior art well known to those skilled in the art, and therefore the description is omitted, the input end of a control panel 124 is respectively electrically connected with the input end of the liquid nitrogen pump main body 211 and the input end of the delivery pump 214 through leads, the device body 100 comprises an extraction device main body 110, one end of the extraction device main body 110 is provided with a feeding port 111, a crushing bin 112 is fixedly installed inside the extraction device main body 110, a crushing mechanism 113 is arranged inside the extraction device main body 110, one end of the crushing mechanism 113 extends to the inside of the crushing bin 112, a filter box 115 is movably installed at the bottom end of the crushing bin 112 inside the extraction device main body 110, a purification box 116 is fixedly installed at the bottom end of the filter box 115 inside the extraction device main body 110, one end of the extraction device main body 110 is fixedly provided with a feed port 117, one end of the feed port 117 penetrates through the extraction device main body 110 and extends into the purification box 116, one end of the extraction device main body 110 is fixedly provided with a filter bin 118, the filter bin 118 is connected with the purification box 116 through a conveying pipe, the extraction device main body 110 is internally provided with a filter mechanism 119, the bottom end of the filter mechanism 119 in the filter bin 118 is movably provided with a waste liquid collecting box 120, one end of the filter bin 118 is fixedly provided with a storage box 121, the interior of the storage box 121 is movably provided with a gene collecting box 122, the front of the storage box 121 is fixedly provided with a control panel 124, the interior of the storage box 121 is provided with a refrigeration mechanism 200, the refrigeration mechanism 200 comprises a fixed box 210, the top end of the storage box 121 is fixedly provided with a fixed box 210, the interior of the fixed box 210 is fixedly provided with a liquid nitrogen pump main body 211, one end of the liquid nitrogen pump main body 211 is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe 212, one end of the connecting pipe 212 penetrates through the fixing box 210 and extends to the inside of the storage box 121, the fixing plate 213 is fixedly installed inside the storage box 121, the delivery pump 214 is fixedly installed inside the fixing plate 213, one end of the delivery pump 214 is fixedly connected with one end of the connecting pipe 212, one end of the delivery pump 214 penetrates through the fixing plate 213 and extends to the inside of the storage box 121, one end of the delivery pump 214 is fixedly provided with the shunt pipe 215, one end of the shunt pipe 215 is uniformly and fixedly provided with the spray head 216, after genes are extracted, liquid nitrogen generated by the liquid nitrogen pump main body 211 and the delivery pump 214 is sprayed to the genes in the gene collection box 122 through the spray head 216 by starting, so that the genes are frozen, the fresh activity of the genes is kept, the pollution and the degradation of the genes are avoided, the research on genetic engineering is facilitated, and the reliability of the device is improved.

Further, the front of extraction element main part 110 and filtration storehouse 118 has all seted up observation window 123, sets up observation window 123 in the front and is convenient for the researcher to look over the inside of equipment, makes the situation that its understanding that can be timely was drawed to be convenient for carry out operation on next step, promoted the reliability of this device.

Further, a sealing mechanism 300 is arranged inside the input port 111, the sealing mechanism 300 includes a cavity 310, one end inside the input port 111 is provided with the cavity 310, the inside of the cavity 310 is fixedly provided with a first connecting shaft 311, one end of the first connecting shaft 311 is movably provided with a sealing plate 312, the inside of the input port 111 is fixedly provided with a fixing block 313, one end of the fixing block 313 is fixedly provided with a first spring 314, one end of the first spring 314 is connected with one end of the sealing plate 312, one end of the input port 111 is fixedly provided with a first connecting plate 315, one end of the first connecting plate 315 is fixedly provided with a second spring 316, one end of the second spring 316 is fixedly connected with a first limiting rod 317, one end of the sealing plate 312 is provided with a limiting groove 318, one end of the first limiting rod 317 penetrates through the input port 111 and extends to the inside of the limiting groove 318, and after the first limiting rod 317 is clamped in the limiting groove 318 by the elasticity of the second spring 316, make closing plate 312 seal up putting in mouth 111 to avoid extracting the in-process, external impurity gets into inside through putting in mouth 111 and causes the influence to the extraction of gene, increased certain extraction efficiency, promoted the security of this device.

Further, the fixed surface of broken mechanism 113 has cup jointed scraper blade 114, and scraper blade 114's one end and the inner wall in broken storehouse 112 laminate mutually, sets up scraper blade 114 and can clean the inner wall in broken storehouse 112, prevents that remaining impurity from attaching to the inner wall in broken storehouse 112, avoids causing the influence to subsequent processing of drawing, has promoted the reliability of this device.

Further, the bottom end of the filtering bin 118 is provided with the discharging mechanism 400, the discharging mechanism 400 includes a fixing frame 410, the bottom end of the filtering bin 118 is fixedly provided with the fixing frame 410, the inside of the fixing frame 410 is movably provided with a transmission screw rod 411, one end of the transmission screw rod 411 extending to the outside of the fixing frame 410 is fixedly provided with a conveying rotating wheel 412, the surface of the transmission screw rod 411 is movably sleeved with a transmission block 413, one end of the transmission block 413 is fixedly provided with a clamping rod 414, the bottom end of the waste liquid collecting box 120 is provided with a first clamping groove 415, one end of the clamping rod 414 penetrates through the fixing frame 410 and extends to the inside of the first clamping groove 415, because the transmission screw rod 411 is clamped inside the first clamping groove 415, the transmission screw rod 411 is rotated by operating the conveying rotating wheel 412, so that the transmission screw rod is driven by the transmission block 413 to drive the clamping rod 414 to move, thereby facilitating the driving of the waste liquid collecting box 120 to move, i.e. facilitating the researchers to take out the waste liquid collecting box, clear up the waste liquid, be convenient for use has promoted the reliability of this device.

Furthermore, a limiting mechanism 500 is arranged at one end of the storage box 121, the limiting mechanism 500 comprises a second connecting plate 510, a second connecting plate 510 is fixedly arranged at one end of the storage box 121, an adjusting bolt 511 is movably arranged in the second connecting plate 510 through a thread, a third connecting plate 512 is movably arranged at one end of the adjusting bolt 511, a second connecting shaft 513 is uniformly and fixedly arranged at one end of the third connecting plate 512, a second limiting rod 514 is movably arranged at one end of the second connecting shaft 513, a third spring 515 is fixedly connected between the two second limiting rods 514, a second clamping groove 516 is formed at one end of the gene collecting box 122, a clamping block 517 is uniformly and fixedly arranged in the second clamping groove 516, one end of the second limiting rod 514 extends into the second clamping groove 516 and is mutually clamped with the clamping block 517, the second limiting rod 514 is clamped with the clamping block 517, and can play a role in fixing and limiting for the gene collecting box 122, prevent that it from taking place the displacement and droing, cause the unrestrained condition of gene to appear, promoted the reliability of this device.

Further, mount 410's inside is provided with slide mechanism 600, slide mechanism 600 includes slide rail 610, mount 410's inside fixed mounting has slide rail 610, spout 611 has been seted up to slide rail 610's one end, the inside slidable mounting of spout 611 has slider 612, and the one end of slider 612 and the one end fixed connection of transmission piece 413, slider 612 is connected the inside that transmission piece 413 slided at spout 611, can play the effect of stabilizing the support to transmission piece 413, make more steady that transmission piece 413 removed, thereby reduce and rock and the wearing and tearing that produce between transmission lead screw 411, and then increased transmission piece 413's life and efficiency, the reliability of this device has been promoted.

The utility model discloses in a biological gene extraction element's use scheme does:

firstly, throwing a material of a living being, which is required to extract genes, into a crushing bin 112 through a throwing port 111, and starting a crushing mechanism 113 to crush substances in the crushing bin 112 so as to separate cell contents from the crushed substances;

step two, after the crushing is finished, stopping the crushing mechanism 113, and enabling impurities and cell contents in the crushing bin 112 to fall into the filter box 115 for filtering;

step three, the solution filtered by the filter box 115 falls into the purification box 116, and then sodium chloride, distilled water and ethanol are sequentially added through the feed inlet 117 to dissolve and purify the solution, so that the internal genes are separated;

and step four, conveying the purified solution to a filtering bin 118 through a conveying pipe, filtering the solution and the purified genes by using a filtering mechanism 119, allowing the filtered waste liquid to fall into a waste liquid collecting box 120 for collection, conveying the remaining genes to a gene collecting box 122 by using the filtering mechanism 119 for collection, and finally starting a refrigerating mechanism 200 for refrigerating and refreshing the genes.
